description: Données réseau TC T2C - Eté 2020 (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte des Transports en Commun de l'Agglomération Clermontoise. T2C transit system data for the summer 2020 period (stops, schedules, etc.). Coverage: Syndicat Mixte des Transports en Commun de l'Agglomération Clermontoise. The portal shows the English title as "TC T2C Network Data — Summer 2020 (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte des Transports en Commun de l'Agglomération Clermontoise. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2020-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
